claims.text: Hotel Des Indes is located on the Lange Voorhout in The Hague.

findings.quote: is located at one of the most beautiful spots in Royal The Hague, on the leafy Lange Voorhout

claims.text: The Binnenhof, Noordeinde Palace, the Mauritshuis, Museum Escher in het Paleis and Panorama Mesdag are all close to the hotel.

findings.quote: The Binnenhof with the Hofvijver, Noordeinde Palace, the Lower House, the Mauritshuis, Museum Escher in het Paleis, and Panorama Mesdag are all just a stone's throw away.

claims.text: The Des Indes Lounge & Restaurant serves lunch, dinner a la carte and a three-course chef's menu.

findings.quote: delicious lunch or dinner à la carte or a 3-course menu du Chef at the Des Indes Lounge & Restaurant

claims.text: Private dining is available for special occasions.

findings.quote: For special occasions to be shared with a select company of people.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has a bathroom with a steam cabin and a spacious living room.

findings.quote: luxurious bathroom (including steam cabin) and spacious living room

claims.text: Many celebrities and heads of state have stayed in the Presidential Suite.

findings.quote: many celebrities and heads of state preceded you

claims.text: Rooms come with Marie Stella Maris care products and a rain shower.

findings.quote:
- Marie Stella Maris care products
- Rain shower

claims.text: All rooms and suites are accessible for guests with disabilities, reached by elevator.

findings.quote: All our rooms and suites are accessible for guests with disabilities. You can use one of our elevators to reach your accommodation.

claims.text: Hotel Des Indes is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.

findings.quote: As a proud member of The Leading Hotels of The World, Hotel Des Indes invites you to join the Leaders Club.

claims.text: Junior Suites have large windows with daylight and a view over The Hague.

findings.quote: The large windows provide plenty of daylight and offer a nice view over The Hague.

claims.text: The hotel offers event spaces with natural daylight for corporate and private events.

findings.quote: Impressive spaces for both corporate and private events, featuring natural daylight in an exclusive and intimate setting.

claims.text: The restaurant's chandeliers, draperies and seating recall the era when Des Indes was a town palace where heads of state were entertained.

findings.quote: The chandeliers, draperies and comfortable seats in the Restaurant are a living monument to the era that Des Indes was a town palace, where heads of state were entertained.

claims.text: High Tea is served daily in the Lounge.

findings.quote:
**High Tea - Lounge**

Daily at 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM, or 2:00 PM.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has a large balcony with a view of Lange Voorhout and The Hague skyline.

findings.quote: From the large balcony you have a beautiful view of Lange Voorhout and the distinctive The Hague skyline.

claims.text: The concierge helps plan bike routes and arranges rental bikes.

findings.quote: Our concierge is ready to help you compile the best bike routes and will make sure your rental bike is ready to go.

claims.text: The chef's dishes are created from premium products of Dutch origin.

findings.quote: the delicious dishes that the Chef has created from premium quality products of Dutch origin

claims.text: This is a city-centre hotel on the Lange Voorhout, amid the government buildings, palaces and museums of The Hague.

findings.quote: The Hague city centre has it all and Hotel Des Indes is right in the midst of it all.
Hotel Des Indes is located in the historic, cultural and royal heart of The Hague.
The Binnenhof with the Hofvijver, Noordeinde Palace, the Lower House, the Mauritshuis, Museum Escher in het Paleis, and Panorama Mesdag are all just a stone's throw away.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes a traditional, formal atmosphere that may not suit casual travelers.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
